snippet.title: Voyage Router - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🌌 The further you go, the more the universe turns against you 🌌
Voyage Router is a navigation-driven roguelike where you chart your path across a procedurally generated overworld.
It blends route-building with resource management.
Terrain, weather, HP, items; every variable matters.
Reassess your path for sudden changes and aim for as many Goal Points as possible!

📌 Scheduled for release in 2026
📝 Add to your wishlist on Steam!
